comment: Curated subset of autoskills.sh registry. Installed via 'pnpm dlx autoskills -y' on 2026-06-06, then manually trimmed. See AGENTS.md §15 for rationale and .agents/skills.disabled/ for excluded skills.

vue.applies_to: Vue 3 Composition API, <script setup>, reactivity, composables

vue-best-practices.applies_to: Vue 3 patterns, component design, animation, async components, props/emit

vue-debug-guides.applies_to: Vue 3 debugging, reactivity issues, devtools, performance

tailwind-css-patterns.applies_to: Tailwind 3, design system, responsive, accessibility, animations

vite.applies_to: Vite 5+, build config, plugin API, HMR, SSR

laravel-specialist.applies_to: Laravel 10+, Eloquent, Sanctum, queues, Livewire, testing, API resources

laravel-patterns.applies_to: Laravel patterns, services, repositories, jobs, events, controllers

excluded.nodejs-backend-patterns: Backend is PHP, not Node.js. Mavis global already has equivalent.
excluded.seo: Internal dental system, not a public site.
excluded.php-pro: Security warning from autoskills (embedded secrets, broad shell commands). Mavis global has 'php-pro' and 'laravel-expert' as safer alternatives.
excluded.format-claude: Duplicate of .agents/ in Claude Code format. Mavis uses .agents/ format.
excluded.format-codebuddy: Duplicate of .agents/ in Codebuddy format. Mavis uses .agents/ format.
